settings.title: Other Work We Quote on Its Own

settings.editor: Pet-friendly and putting-green turf for front yards, back yards, and play areas. We remove the old lawn, compact a draining base, then seam, nail, and infill so the lawn stays flat. Backed by a 15-year warranty.

Common jobs
Front lawn replacement, backyard putting greens, dog runs, shaded side yards, and tear-outs of turf laid over the wrong base.
Paver patios, walkways, driveways, and pool decks. Correct base depth, bedding sand, and edge restraints are what keep pavers from shifting, so that is where the labor goes.
